import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(input[0])
    s = list(input[1].strip())
    tokens = input[2].strip().split()
    beauty = list(map(int, tokens))
    totalSum = sum(beauty)
    mismatchCount = 0
    freqCount = [0] * 26
    sumOfPairs = 0
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if s[i] == s[n - i - 1]:
            mismatchCount += 1
            freqCount[ord(s[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
            sumOfPairs += min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1])
    maxFreqVal = 0
    maxCharIdx = 0
    for i in range(26):
        if freqCount[i] > maxFreqVal:
            maxFreqVal = freqCount[i]
            maxCharIdx = i
    if 2 * maxFreqVal <= mismatchCount:
        print(totalSum)
        return
    candidates = []
    for i in range(n // 2):
        if (ord(s[i]) - ord('a')) != maxCharIdx and (ord(s[n - i - 1]) - ord('a')) != maxCharIdx and s[i] != s[n - i - 1]:
            candidates.append(min(beauty[i], beauty[n - i - 1]))
    candidates.sort()
    removeCount = 2 * maxFreqVal - mismatchCount
    for i in range(removeCount):
        totalSum -= candidates[i]
    print(totalSum)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
